name: Decollatura (Italy)
description: Vertical tricolour of green, white and red, the white charged with the crowned municipal arms of Decollatura (a tree above three hills on white) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Decollatura, a comune in Calabria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 2 March 1984.

features.role: Decollatura arms — tree above three hills on white, crowned, within branches
